描述_EN: this jar belongs to the so-called longquan wares, characterised by greenish or celadon glazes, and named after an important production area in south china active from the song (960-1279) to the early qing dynasty (1644-1911). this inscription also appears on other pieces produced in the longquan kilns, and possibly represents a trade mark. the longquan vessels were often decorated with designs incised, carved, moulded or applied in relief on the surface, and then covered with the glaze. it is of particular interest for the four chinese ideograms carved in relief under the glaze: 'mei jiu qing xiang' (fine wine, pure fragrance), which directly refer to the function of the jar. a plug would have sealed the mouth. this example, with a short, small neck, was used to serve wine.
描述_ZN: 此罐属于所谓的龙泉器，其特点是绿色或青瓷釉，并以中国南方的一个重要产区命名，该产区从宋朝（960-1279）到清朝早期（1644-1911）都很活跃。 此铭文也出现在龙泉窑生产的其他器物上，可能代表一种商业标记。 龙泉器皿通常以刻、雕、模或浮雕的方式装饰在表面，然后用釉面覆盖。 它对釉下浮雕的四个中国字母特别感兴趣： 梅酒清香"，这直接指的是该罐子的功能。 一个塞子会封住口。 这个例子，有一个短小的颈部，是用来盛酒的。
